component_findings.c_native: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--zig): Community forum threads show integration gaps being actively worked around rather than solved by mature libraries, e.g. users asking for a native EdgeDB driver or MySQL driver options for Zig web projects.
component_findings.database_data: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--zig): Community-maintained integrations exist for common external systems: native PostgreSQL drivers (pg.zig, multiple forks), and a Zigistry-listed collection covering 'Postgres and SQLite, S3, an HTTP client, a job queue in your database, JWT, cache, config, password hashing,' plus Redis client SDKs and HTTP/1.1/2/3-over-QUIC/WebSocket/TLS 1.3/protobuf network frameworks.
component_findings.extension_embedding: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--zig): Community-maintained integrations exist for common external systems: native PostgreSQL drivers (pg.zig, multiple forks), and a Zigistry-listed collection covering 'Postgres and SQLite, S3, an HTTP client, a job queue in your database, JWT, cache, config, password hashing,' plus Redis client SDKs and HTTP/1.1/2/3-over-QUIC/WebSocket/TLS 1.3/protobuf network frameworks.
component_findings.language_bindings: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--zig): Third-party tooling to embed Zig into other ecosystems does exist (e.g. the Vezel Zig SDK integrates Zig/C/C++ builds into the .NET/MSBuild/NuGet pipeline), showing some cross-ecosystem integration capability built on Zig's C-toolchain and cross-compilation features, but this is a community project, not an official Zig Software Foundation deliverable.
component_findings.network_cloud: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-5--zig): Breadth and reliability of working integrations with external systems (databases, cloud provider services, messaging/network protocols, web frameworks), plus the maturity of supply-chain/registry tooling (SBOM, dependency scanners, centralized package registry) that lets those integrations be tracked and consumed reliably.
